storyCards.headline: She's A Rainbow: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Rolling Stones's "She's A Rainbow" reached #25 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #25 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 7 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Singles Collection - The London Years" (1989) — not the song's original release year.
